added.summary: A focused Input takes the platform's input method in a native window as it does on the web: Chinese, Japanese and Korean preedit shows underlined at the caret and commits into the field, the candidate window opens at the caret, Ctrl+C/X (Cmd on macOS) put the selection on the OS clipboard and Ctrl+V pastes from it.

fixed.summary: An input method's commit and the next word's preedit arriving in one frame no longer lose the preedit. A pasted line break becomes a space in a one-line Input (it was dropped, joining the words) and a newline in a multi-line one, Windows' CRLF included. On the web, the input method's candidate window opens at the caret instead of the field's left edge.
